An alternative edge panel for Samsung One UI phones.

EdgeLite is an independent project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Samsung Electronics. Samsung, One UI, and Edge Panel are trademarks of their respective owners, mentioned here only to describe compatibility.

Tap Enable panel. Accessibility settings will open. Choose Installed apps, tap EdgeLite Panel, then turn it on. Samsung shows a standard warning for every accessibility service. This service does not read your screen.
Tap Choose apps, tick the apps you want in the panel, then tap Save.
Swipe the handle on the screen edge inward, or tap it. Tap an icon to open that app.
4. Optional, protect it from battery saving
Tap the Ignore battery optimization row until its status shows Active.

Android only lets a regular app show a handle over other apps through a foreground service with a notification. With an accessibility service, the handle and panel appear without a notification and do not show up in Check background activity, just like Samsung\'s built-in features.
What it does and does not do

EdgeLite only draws the handle and the panel. The service does not read the screen, does not receive any events, and does not collect data. The warning shown when you turn it on is the standard Android warning for all accessibility services.

Open Settings, Accessibility, Installed apps, tap EdgeLite Panel, switch it on, then tap Allow. Shortcut: tap the Accessibility service row on the EdgeLite home screen, or the Enable panel button. Menu names may differ slightly between One UI versions.

Tap Disable in EdgeLite to hide the handle only. To fully deactivate the service, switch off EdgeLite Panel in Accessibility, Installed apps. If the switch is greyed out when you try to turn it on, see the fix under Troubleshooting.

Open the Export and import category, tap Export, and save the file. Uninstall the old version, install the new one, then tap Import and choose that file. Turn the EdgeLite Panel service on again in Accessibility, because uninstalling also turned it off. Panel apps that are not installed on the phone are skipped.

Open the three dot menu, choose Developer options, then turn on Enable freeform windows and Force activities to be resizable. Restart the phone if windows do not change yet. If Developer options is not visible, tap Build number 7 times in Settings, About phone, Software information.
The accessibility service switch is greyed out and cannot be turned on

Android 13 and above restricts apps installed from an APK file. Open Settings, Apps, EdgeLite Panel, tap the three dots at the top right, choose Allow restricted settings, then try turning it on again. If that menu is not there yet, tap the service switch once, go back, and check again.
The panel does not start after a restart

Make sure the EdgeLite Panel service is still on in Accessibility, Autostart in the General category is on, and the PANEL label says ACTIVE before the phone restarts. The panel appears after the phone finishes booting and is unlocked. If you turned the panel off with the Disable button or the tile before restarting, it correctly stays off.
The accessibility service turns itself off

Do not use Force stop in app info, because Android then turns the service off. Turn on Ignore battery optimization. On Samsung, open Settings, Battery, Background usage limits, then remove EdgeLite from Sleeping apps and add it to Never sleeping apps. Menu names may differ between One UI versions.
Apps open fullscreen instead of in a window

Check that Default open mode in the General category is Window. Make sure both freeform options in Developer options are on. Some apps do not support resizing and ignore the window size, which is not an EdgeLite fault.
The handle conflicts with the back gesture
Move the handle position up or down in the Side and handle category, or move it to the other side. You can also lower the back gesture sensitivity in Samsung navigation settings if available.
Settings do not change right away
Sliders apply their value when you lift your finger, and the change shows after the panel is reopened. If it still looks the same, tap Disable and then Enable panel.
An app does not appear in the panel
Open Choose apps and make sure the app is ticked. Apps that were uninstalled from the phone are skipped automatically.
The Enable panel button does not show the handle
Check that the EdgeLite Panel service is on in Accessibility. Without it the panel cannot be shown.
Actual proportions on this phone. The bar on the edge is the handle, and the icons are your pinned apps.
